chapters.reason: TESS applies diffusion on the logit simplex space, which is a continuous representation analogous to token embeddings, aligning with embedding-based diffusion models that operate on continuous representations rather than discrete token masking.

The paper focuses on non-autoregressive text generation using diffusion, which shares the goal of simultaneous token prediction with masked diffusion models, though TESS uses a continuous simplex space instead of discrete masking.

TESS is compared to autoregressive models and aims for competitive performance, but it is explicitly non-autoregressive; the hybrid AR-diffusion category is less relevant as TESS does not integrate autoregressive components directly.
